theory.body: Without Data Pipeline Scheduling, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.body: Data Pipeline Scheduling offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
